# Ayodele John

> Nigeria-based software engineer building production-grade platforms end-to-end, from backend systems to the interfaces that ship them. Specializes in backend and API engineering (NestJS/Node.js/TypeScript), fintech and payments systems, cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes), full-stack product delivery (React, Next.js, React Native), and AI/LLM integration. Open to remote full-time roles and contract/consulting engagements worldwide.

## Background

- Lead Backend Engineer, [Sonaroid](https://sonaroid.io/) (Lagos, Nigeria), Jan 2026 to present. Sonaroid provides authentic data and deep insights into Africa's energy industry through a multi-currency subscription platform. Built that subscription and payments layer (NestJS, TypeScript, Paystack, Flutterwave), a recommendation engine (+30% session duration), and an earnings ledger with an auditable withdrawal state machine.
- Software Engineer, ToksNet Africa (Abuja, Nigeria), Jun 2024 to Dec 2025. Led migration from monolith to microservices on Kubernetes/Docker (+15% performance, -25% deploy time), an ML-powered recommendation engine (-20% churn), and AI-driven security protocol implementation.
- B.Sc. Biology, University of Benin (2021). Diploma in Computer Science, Xoft Tech Academy (2020).
- AWS Certified Developer - Associate (2024). Google Associate Cloud Engineer (2023). Certified ScrumMaster (2023).

## Services

- Backend & API Engineering: NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, REST, GraphQL, microservices.
- Fintech & Payments Systems: multi-currency billing, Paystack/Flutterwave integration, FX-rate locking, earnings ledgers, withdrawal workflows, coupon/discount engines.
- Full-Stack Product Delivery: React, Next.js, React Native, product and UX direction end to end.
- AI Engineering: LLM/OpenAI integration, recommendation systems, AI-driven product features.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
- Data Engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, Apache Spark/Kafka, Azure Data Factory/Databricks.
